summary_en: The paper presents an automated signal-domain framework that estimates irregular tissue boundaries from raw measurements of a 1,024-element hemispherical PACT array and applies an equivalent dual-speed-of-sound temporal-compression model to realign aberrated wavefronts. Simulations, irregular phantoms, and in vivo mouse-liver experiments show improved vascular morphology and robustness under degraded signal-to-noise conditions.

summary_en: This prospective 29-patient study evaluates co-registered photoacoustic and ultrasound imaging for differentiating benign and malignant subungual tumors. Malignant lesions showed substantially lower oxygen saturation, and the oxygen-saturation metric achieved an AUC of 0.980, illustrating the value of combining ultrasound morphology with photoacoustic functional contrast.
